author: Robb Bryan
text: If you walk away from your phone for an extended period this will happen. It usually comes back. If not restart the Bluetooth. If that doesn't work restart your phone. If it doesn't come back you may have compromised your sensor. Give it sometime after  each try. It takes a few to reconnect. If it still doesn't work you may need to switch sensors.

author: Ronald Murchison
text: Go to the app settings and make sure they're turned on.
